title: Newton square root
prompt: Implement `newton_sqrt(x, iters=20)` for x>=0 using Newton iteration starting from x or 1. Return float.
test_source:
import math
import solution

def run():
    assert abs(solution.newton_sqrt(9)-3)<1e-10
    assert abs(solution.newton_sqrt(2)-math.sqrt(2))<1e-10
    assert solution.newton_sqrt(0)==0
